member_names: Yang X. Peng Z. Zhu Q. Chen C. Liu J. Fu S. Analysis
title: Microbial Communities and Fermentation Processes in Food Production
summary: This cluster revolves around the study of microbial communities and their involvement in various fermentation processes and food production. The research, as seen in Yang X. Peng Z. Zhu Q. Chen C. Liu J. Fu S. Analysis, is connected to the production of Tieguanyin, which in turn is related to the formation of aged aroma compounds. The fermentation process is also linked to the production of rosy vinegar, which is associated with purebred microorganisms. Additionally, the study of microbial communities LWT is connected to the concept of correlation, highlighting the intricate relationships between these entities in the context of food production and microbial communities.
